metaTitle: Awakening to the Self — Christine CAL
metaDesc: Exploring something greater than yourself: galactic memory, Mount Shasta & the new TELOS, the energies of Bugarach and the galactic team of the New Earth.
lede: Recovering your galactic memory, taking part in the creation of the New Earth and exploring 5th-Dimension places.
intro: The conscious personality, now a partner of the Soul, continues the adventure. It prepares for the fusion with the Higher SELF or I AM Presence, the non-incarnated part to be integrated through the multidimensional ascension process.
The Soul then synthesises this cycle and reintegrates its Earthly fractals.
Through the radiance of its frequency, it calls its Monadic family.
Remembering, reconnecting, finding one another becomes a need, even a necessity, to complete one's individual and collective mission.
The SELF or I AM Presence uses the 5D energies to descend gradually into the Soul, structured by its geometry and transformed into a true vehicle of light.
Connections with so-called future fractals or galactic parts allow the conscious Being, helped by Inner-Earth or Extraterrestrial Elder Brothers, to rediscover their true galactic family and history.
outro: The chartered accountant I once was makes sure I keep a critical, analytical mind, and check and assess the risks in all my approaches
An invitation to discernment — Respect for free thought
